omitted_because: Descriptions are long and prose-only; the semantics this lane relies on are quoted in docs/compat/cloudcli-windows-1.41.0.md.

project.description: A project reference: an exact id, an absolute directory path, or a name. A name resolves most-specific-first (exact id, then full path, then an exact title, then a case-insensitive title substring); an ambiguous or unknown reference is refused, never guessed. Write tools accept only an exact id, path or title.

query.description: Literal text to find in stored session transcripts and titles. Not semantic.

project.description: Restrict to one project reference, or several to aggregate across.

cursor.description: Continuation token from a previous call. Not stable across calls.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound on a session last activity (ISO 8601). Out-of-window sessions are never scanned.

until.description: Inclusive upper bound on a session last activity (ISO 8601). See `since`.

mode.description: Reserved; the only accepted value is 'fulltext'.
